definitions.gloss: to be discouraged; to be disappointed; to lose heart
definitions.explanation: To feel deeply disappointed or disheartened, especially after hopes or expectations are not met. Stronger than simple disappointment — implies a significant emotional letdown.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧{落胆|らくたん}した。
examples.english: I was discouraged when I heard the results.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちて→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ひどく→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧{落胆|らくたん}して⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He was deeply disappointed after failing the exam.

examples.japanese: {落胆|らくたん}する{気持|きも}ち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦チャンス→チャンス：03857_chansu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I understand your disappointment, but there are still chances.

notes:
Composed of {落|らく} (fall) + {胆|たん} (gallbladder/courage), literally 'one's courage falls.' A somewhat formal word that conveys deep disappointment. The noun form ⟦{落胆|らくたん}→落胆：04860_rakutan⟧ is also commonly used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ひどく→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧{落胆|らくたん}する: to be deeply discouraged
- ⟦{落胆|らくたん}→落胆：04860_rakutan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧: to show signs of disappointment
- ⟦{落胆|らくたん}→落胆：04860_rakutan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{隠|かく}す→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧: to hide one's disappointment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦がっかりする→がっかりする：21758_gakkarisuru⟧: to be disappointed — more casual, everyday usage
- ⟦{失望|しつぼう}する→失望する：21757_shitsubousuru⟧: to be disillusioned — more formal, often implies loss of trust or faith
- ⟦{意気消沈|いきしょうちん}→意気消沈：15735_ikishouchin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be completely dejected — stronger, implies total loss of motivation
